mutants.name: selfhost-fix-imports-go-order
mutants.rule: Canonical import sorting places Ergo imports before Go imports.

mutants.name: selfhost-fix-imports-drops-used
mutants.rule: Import pruning keeps imports whose qualifier resolves outside package declarations.

mutants.name: selfhost-fix-lawfix-ignores-tests
mutants.rule: S115 co-location moves both top-level law and top-level test declarations beside their subjects.

mutants.name: selfhost-fix-lawfix-helper-churns
mutants.rule: An exclusive helper stays put if any user stays or arrives in its file, guaranteeing idempotency.

mutants.name: selfhost-fix-lawfix-ambiguity-bypass
mutants.rule: Ambiguous subject ties across distinct files must be guarded instead of moving arbitrarily.

mutants.name: selfhost-fix-lawfix-keeps-empty-file
mutants.rule: Files left with no non-import declarations after moves are recorded as Deleted.

mutants.name: selfhost-fix-lawfix-skips-leftover-join
mutants.rule: Unplaced leftover tests in a laws file join an existing tests.ergo when present.

mutants.name: selfhost-fix-lawfix-drops-rename-concept
mutants.rule: A remaining laws file holding non-law declarations renames after its primary concept.

mutants.name: selfhost-fix-len-ignores-shadow
mutants.rule: User-declared len in package scope must never be rewritten to .Len().

mutants.name: selfhost-fix-len-drops-conversion-parens
mutants.rule: Type conversion arguments inside len(string(x)) require outer parentheses before .Len().

mutants.name: selfhost-fix-mut-rewrites-typearg
mutants.rule: *T inside non-FuncType type arguments must remain unrewritten and be reported in KeptLines.

mutants.name: selfhost-fix-stdtypes-ignores-local-shadow
mutants.rule: StdTypes skips qualification inside declarations where a local variable shadows the std package qualifier.

mutants.name: selfhost-fix-globalfuncs-drops-alias-clash
mutants.rule: GlobalFuncs selects a collision-free std<pkg> import alias when the default qualifier clashes.
